|errata_history=This is version PC-E1 (2 of 2), 9 March 2026. It is the current text. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' ([[My Sister Has It]]): PC card image of 9 April 2025<ref name="ht-msh-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e6f69d5/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/mysisterhasit.gif mysisterhasit.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e6f69d5 e6f69d5] (9 April 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Virtual Set 25 preview card. The same text is printed on the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF built 10 August 2025, page 9). Text: “During battle involving Rebel Leia, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited. OR Subtract 1 from a just drawn Force Lightning or 'choke' destiny (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, ▲ Chief Chirpa's Hut or Guest Quarters.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-msh-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/mysisterhasit.gif mysisterhasit.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f23e07 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (marked “E1”): the card changes from a Used Interrupt to a Used or Lost Interrupt: the first option (“During battle involving Rebel Leia, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited.”) is removed, the other two become the USED text, and a LOST text is added (“If Leia in battle, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.”). Text: “USED: Subtract 1 from a just drawn Force Lightning or 'choke' destiny (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, ▲ Chief Chirpa's Hut or Guest Quarters. LOST: If Leia in battle, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.”

|rulings=* First function: The phrase 'unless targeting an [[Undercover]] spy' applies to both [[Force Lightning]] and 'choke' destiny draws.<ref name="scomp" />

* Third function: If a card is both gaining immunity (e.g. [[Yavin 4: Jungle]]) and losing immunity (e.g. [[My Sister Has It]]), the removing of immunity wins.
